correctness.rationale: At Hessian rank four the adjugate is a rank-one projector. Its determinant derivatives impose cyclic multiplicative recurrences on the kernel vector, giving exactly the eleven projective roots-of-unity vectors. Cubic Hessian symmetry forces each singular base point to coincide with its kernel vector; a diagonal automorphism transports the rank-four diagonal case. The computed local quadratic cone has determinant 5 = 2 modulo 3, establishing ordinary nodes. Frobenius multiplication by 3 on order-11 roots has cycles 1,5,5. Exact symbolic replay checks critical identities; geometric completeness is a proof rather than extrapolation.

value.rationale: The corank-one singular stratum of the canonical Hessian quintic of a classical symmetric cubic is an intrinsic geometric object. The complete classification as eleven ordinary nodes off the cubic and their nontrivial Frobenius splitting give useful specific singularity and arithmetic information for exceptional-characteristic geometry, beyond a routine calculation at one point.
